title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 1: the call to return, the man among the myrtle trees, and the four horns and four craftsmen.

questions.text: Whose son was Zechariah the prophet, according to the opening verse?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word came to Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet.

questions.text: What message was Zechariah to tell them from Yahweh of Armies?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says, "Return to me, and I will return to you."

answers.text: "Wait for me, and I will come."
"Build for me, and I will bless you."
"Return to me, and I will return to you."
"Call on me, and I will answer you."

questions.text: How did the fathers respond when the former prophets proclaimed to them?
questions.explanation: The former prophets called them to return from their evil ways, but they did not hear, nor listen to Yahweh.

answers.text: They did not hear or listen

questions.text: In the night vision, what was the man among the myrtle trees riding?
questions.explanation: Zechariah saw a man riding on a red horse, standing among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine.

questions.text: What colors were the horses behind him?
questions.explanation: Behind the man there were red, brown, and white horses.

questions.text: What did those who had walked back and forth through the earth report?
questions.explanation: They reported that they had walked back and forth through the earth, and that all the earth was at rest and in peace.

answers.text: That all the earth was at rest and in peace
That the nations were at war
That the land was burned with fire

questions.text: How long had Yahweh had indignation against Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, according to the angel's question?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's angel asked how long he would not have mercy on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, against which he had had indignation these seventy years.

questions.text: What does Yahweh of Armies say he is for Jerusalem and for Zion?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says, "I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy."

answers.text: Jealous for them with a great jealousy

questions.text: What did Zechariah see when he lifted up his eyes after this?
questions.explanation: He lifted up his eyes, and saw, and behold, four horns.

questions.text: What did Yahweh show him next, and what had these come to do?
questions.explanation: Yahweh showed him four craftsmen, who had come to terrify the horns and to cast down the horns of the nations.

answers.text: Four craftsmen, to cast down the horns
Four priests, to bless the city
Four angels, to measure the land
Four shepherds, to gather the flock
